snippet.title: Teaser: Sons of Odin (Demo)
snippet.description:
Sons of Odin is a tactical card game with short and dynamic matches.
Pick your hero, use unique abilities, and adapt to shifting rules. Every game is an intense card duel where strategy, quick thinking and adaptability decide the winner.

What to expect:
Short and dynamic matches
Unique heroes with active and passive skills
Godlike powers that turn the battle around
Coins and runes that flip the rules mid game
PvP modes: 1v1 duels and four player battles

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642720/Synovya_Odina__Sons_of_Odin/
